content:
**Highway 62** is a roadway in *Fallout 76*.

The roadway crosses the Appalachian region, having served as thoroughfare in West Virginia before the Great War.

Marked east to west. Serves as the border of the Whitespring grounds to the east. Behinds north of the resort and progresses southbound, turning west toward the Miners Monument and ending in Charleston.

Highway 62 appears in *Fallout 76*.
